extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the pursuer in a financial provision action at Edinburgh Sheriff Court asks whether we lend in Scotland, seeking £40,000 against matrimonial property of around £400,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the details of your client's financial provision action. Please note our funding is directed at proceedings in England and Wales, and a colleague will confirm our position on Scottish matters. To progress the review, we would need confirmation of the court and jurisdiction, the date of any next hearing or proof diet, a breakdown of the costs the £40,000 would cover, and details of the matrimonial property and any existing charges over it. Client identification and your firm's engagement details would also be helpful. We will come back to you once this has been considered.
